_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/costs/test_targeting_each_reduction.py and tests/unit/triggers/test_double_triggers_dealt_damage.py. Never part of a deck list. t_wy_fighter is Wayta's activated ability without its {T}; t_wy_doubler is Wayta's last line on a plain enchantment; t_wy_pinger gains 1 life whenever a creature you control deals damage to a player, the half the doubler must not reach.

cards.name: Test Wy Fighter
cards.oracle_text: {2}{G}: Target creature you control fights another target creature. This ability costs {2} less to activate if it targets two creatures you control.

abilities.text: {2}{G}: Target creature you control fights another target creature. This ability costs {2} less to activate if it targets two creatures you control.

cards.name: Test Wy Doubler
cards.oracle_text: If a creature you control being dealt damage causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

abilities.text: If a creature you control being dealt damage causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

cards.name: Test Wy Pinger
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a creature you control deals damage to a player, you gain 1 life.

abilities.text: Whenever a creature you control deals damage to a player, you gain 1 life.
